'''Rancor Blood''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage, that could be purchased in the [[Raging Rancor Cantina]]. It was dark red and [[Salt/Legends|salty]], resembling the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] of a [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]].
